title: Morphir IR Distribution
description:
Morphir IR format version 4.

V4 introduces key improvements:
- Wrapper object format for distributions (replaces tagged arrays)
- Object/dict format for modules, types, values, and dependencies
- Explicit TypeAttributes and ValueAttributes
- Canonical string formats for names, paths, and FQNames
- Embedded documentation support
- New value expression (Hole) and definition bodies (NativeBody, ExternalBody, IncompleteBody)
- DocumentLiteral, a schema-less JSON-like literal (decision 0013)

See the complete example at: docs/spec/ir/schemas/v4/complete-example.json

FormatVersion.description: The IR format version, governed by the v3-and-later formatVersion contract. Integer 4 is the canonical v4.0.0 baseline; exact release strings identify later revisions in the v4 family. Prerelease and build metadata are not allowed

NameString.description:
Canonical string representation of a name: segments joined by "-".
A segment is all-lowercase (a word) or all-uppercase (an initialism).
Digits are permitted in both; a digits-only segment is a word.
A mixed-case segment such as "Usd" is invalid.

oneOf.description:
Legacy v1-v3 array representation. On decode, each maximal run of two or
more single-letter entries collapses into one initialism; a run of one
stays a word. ["value","in","u","s","d"] decodes to "value-in-USD",
and ["a"] decodes to "a".

PathString.description:
Canonical string representation of a path (package or module path).
Segments are Names joined by forward slashes.

oneOf.description: Legacy array representation (e.g., [["morphir"], ["s", "d", "k"]] for 'morphir/SDK')

ModuleName.description: Module path within a package. Examples: "basics", "list", "domain/users"

FQNameString.description:
Fully-qualified name in canonical string format: "package:module#name"
This uniquely identifies a type or value across the entire IR.

oneOf.description: Legacy array representation: [packageName, moduleName, name]

SourceLocation.description: Source code location for error reporting and IDE support

TypeAttributes.description:
V4 explicit type attributes replacing generic 'a' parameter.
Contains source location, type constraints, and extensibility hooks.

ValueAttributes.description:
V4 explicit value attributes replacing generic 'a' parameter.
Contains source location, inferred type, and extensibility hooks.

Annotation.description:
Structured annotation on a specification type.
Can be a compact string or a canonical object.

oneOf.description:
Compact shorthand format for an annotation: "fqname" or "fqname:value".
Examples:
- "morphir/SDK:annotations#stable"
- "my-org/sdk:annotations#deprecated:Use new-version instead"

arguments.description: Arguments to the annotation (positional or named)

AnnotationArgument.description: An argument to an annotation, either positional (Value) or named.

oneOf.description: Positional argument
Named argument

Access.description:
Visibility level for definitions.
Canonical: "Public" or "Private"
Accepted: lowercase ("public", "private") and abbreviation ("pub" for Public)

Encoders should output the canonical form.

Doc.description:
Documentation text. Decision 0010 places "doc" first, flattened beside the
variant it documents, rather than in a nested { "doc", "value" } wrapper.

oneOf.description: Nested wrapper, accepted for one release (decision 0010)
Nested wrapper, accepted for one release (decision 0010)

DocumentedTypeSpecification.description:
A type specification, documented or not.
Canonical: { "doc": "...", "OpaqueTypeSpecification": {} }

oneOf.description: Nested wrapper, accepted for one release (decision 0010)
Nested wrapper, accepted for one release (decision 0010)

AccessControlledTypeDefinition.description:
An access-controlled type definition, the entry shape of ModuleDefinition.types.
Canonical: { "Public": { "doc": "...", "TypeAliasDefinition": {...} } }
Accepted: { "access": "Public", "TypeAliasDefinition": {...} } and the lowercase
and "pub" spellings of the access level.

AccessControlledValueDefinition.description:
An access-controlled value definition, the entry shape of ModuleDefinition.values.
Canonical: { "Public": { "doc": "...", "ExpressionBody": {...} } }

Dependencies.description:
Dictionary mapping package names to their specifications.
V4 uses object format: { "package/name": { "modules": {...} } }

PackageDefinition.description:
Full package definition containing all modules with their complete implementations.
Used in Library and Application distributions. The "modules" field can be omitted
if empty.

PackageSpecification.description:
Package specification containing only public interfaces (no implementations).
Used in dependencies and Specs distributions. The "modules" field can be omitted
if empty.

LibraryDistribution.description:
Library distribution - a reusable package with full implementations.
Used for libraries that can be imported by other packages.
The "dependencies" and "def" fields can be omitted if empty.

SpecsDistribution.description:
Specs distribution - contains only public interfaces/specifications.
Used for dependencies or FFI bindings where implementations are not needed.
The "dependencies" and "spec" fields can be omitted if empty.

ApplicationDistribution.description:
Application distribution - an executable package with statically linked dependencies.
Contains named entry points that can be invoked by tooling or runtime.
The "dependencies" and "def" fields can be omitted if empty.

entryPoints.description:
Map of entry point names (keys) to their definitions.

The key is an arbitrary identifier chosen by the developer (e.g., "startup", "build", "api-handler").
The EntryPoint object contains a "kind" field that categorizes it semantically (main, command, handler, job, policy).

Example: An entry point named "startup" can have kind "main", or "api-handler" can have kind "handler".
The name and kind can differ - the name is for identification, the kind is for semantic categorization.

ApplicationDependencies.description:
Dictionary mapping package names to full definitions (statically linked for Application distributions).
Unlike Library dependencies which use specifications, Application dependencies include full implementations
for static linking.

EntryPoint.description:
Defines an entry point for an Application distribution.
The entry point name (the dictionary key) is arbitrary, while 'kind' provides semantic categorization.

target.description: Fully-qualified name of the value to invoke

kind.description:
Semantic category of this entry point. Note: This is distinct from the entry point name (the dictionary key).
The name is an arbitrary identifier, while kind is a semantic category from a fixed set.

EntryPointKind.description:
Semantic category for entry points. Used by tooling and runtime to determine behavior.

- "main": Default/primary entry point (like application startup)
- "command": CLI subcommand
- "handler": Service endpoint or message handler
- "job": Batch or scheduled job
- "policy": Business policy or rule

ModuleDefinition.description:
Full module definition containing all types and values with their implementations.
Includes both public and private items. Used in PackageDefinition.
The "types" and "values" fields can be omitted if empty.

Canonical: "doc" flattened first beside the variant (decision 0010); the nested
{ "doc", "value" } form is accepted for one release.

ModuleSpecification.description:
Module specification containing only public interfaces (no implementations).
Used in PackageSpecification and dependencies.
The "types" and "values" fields can be omitted if empty.

Canonical: "doc" flattened first beside the variant (decision 0010); the nested
{ "doc", "value" } form is accepted for one release.

VariableType.description:
Type variable (generic type parameter).
Compact: "a"; expanded: {"Variable": {"attributes": {...}, "name": "a"}}

oneOf.description:
Compact format: bare name string (no ':' or '#').
Distinguished from Reference by absence of FQName separators.

Compact format for Reference without type arguments.
Just the FQName string: "package:module#name"
Wrapper format for Reference without type arguments.
Canonical format for Reference with type arguments.

Reference.description: Array where first element is FQName, rest are type arguments.

oneOf.description: Expanded wrapper format with explicit fqname and args fields.

Reference.description: Object with optional attributes, fqname, and optional args fields.

oneOf.description: Bare array of types. Unambiguous because ReferenceType does not accept bare arrays.
Canonical wrapper format with array of types.
Expanded wrapper format with optional attributes and an explicit elements field.

fields.description: Dictionary mapping field names (kebab-case) to their types.

UnitType.description:
Unit type (the type with exactly one value).
Compact: {"Unit": {}}; expanded: {"Unit": {"attributes": {...}}}

DerivedTypeSpecification.description:
Derived type specification (opaque with conversion functions).
V4 format: { "DerivedTypeSpecification": { "typeParams": [...], "baseType": ..., "fromBaseType": ..., "toBaseType": ... } }

IncompleteTypeDefinition.description:
Incomplete type definition (V4 feature for best-effort support).
Used when a type definition cannot be fully resolved.

oneOf.description: Object mapping constructor names to their parameter lists (decision 0007)
Shorthand for BoolLiteral
Shorthand for IntegerLiteral or FloatLiteral, by lexeme (decision 0009)
Shorthand for Reference (FQName string)
Shorthand for Variable (Name string)
Shorthand for List (decision 0009); a Tuple always carries its wrapper
Canonical wrapper format with array of values.
Expanded wrapper format with optional attributes and an explicit elements field.
Canonical wrapper format with array of values.
Expanded wrapper format with optional attributes and an explicit items field.

fields.description: Dictionary mapping field names (kebab-case) to their values.

VariableValue.description:
Reference to a variable in scope.
Compact: {"Variable": "variable-name"}; expanded: {"Variable": {"attributes": {...}, "name": "variable-name"}}

ReferenceValue.description:
Reference to a defined value (function or constant).
Compact: {"Reference": "package:module#name"}; expanded: {"Reference": {"attributes": {...}, "fqname": "package:module#name"}}

FieldValue.description:
Field access on a record.
Format: {"Field": {"target": value, "name": "field-name"}}
The older "subject" and "fieldName" are legacy spellings readers accept for one
release (decision 0006); they are not valid here.

FieldFunctionValue.description:
A function that extracts a field.
Compact: {"FieldFunction": "field-name"}; expanded: {"FieldFunction": {"attributes": {...}, "name": "field-name"}}

ApplyValue.description:
Function application: an argument is applied to a function (decision 0007).
Format: {"Apply": {"function": value, "argument": value}}

LetDefinitionValue.description:
Let binding introducing a single value.
Format: {"LetDefinition": {"name": "x", "definition": {...}, "in": value}}
The older "valueName", "valueDefinition", and "inValue" are legacy spellings
readers accept for one release (decision 0006); they are not valid here.

LetRecursionValue.description:
Mutually recursive let bindings.
Format: {"LetRecursion": {"definitions": {"f": {...}, "g": {...}}, "in": value}}

DestructureValue.description:
Pattern-based destructuring.
Format: {"Destructure": {"pattern": pattern, "value": value, "in": value}}

IfThenElseValue.description:
Conditional expression.
Format: {"IfThenElse": {"condition": value, "then": value, "else": value}}
The older "thenBranch" and "elseBranch" are legacy spellings readers accept for
one release (decision 0006); they are not valid here.

PatternMatchValue.description:
Pattern matching with multiple cases.
Format: {"PatternMatch": {"value": value, "cases": [{"pattern": ..., "body": ...}, ...]}}

UpdateRecordValue.description:
Record update expression.
Format: {"UpdateRecord": {"target": value, "fields": {"field-name": value, ...}}}

HoleValue.description:
A missing expression (decision 0008). Hole is the only V4-specific value
expression: native and external operations are definition bodies (NativeBody,
ExternalBody), not expressions, and a reader refuses "Native" or "External" at
value position as an unknown node.

expectedType.description: Optional type the missing expression was expected to have

AsPattern.description:
As pattern (binds matched value to a name).
Format: {"AsPattern": {"pattern": pattern, "name": "x"}}

oneOf.description: Bare array of patterns. Unambiguous because no other pattern type uses bare arrays.
Canonical wrapper format with array of patterns.
Expanded wrapper format with optional attributes and an explicit patterns field.

ConstructorPattern.description:
Constructor pattern for custom type matching.
Format: {"ConstructorPattern": {"fqname": "package:module#ctor", "patterns": [...]}}

EmptyListPattern.description:
Pattern matching an empty list.
Compact: {"EmptyListPattern": {}}; expanded: {"EmptyListPattern": {"attributes": {...}}}

HeadTailPattern.description:
Pattern matching head and tail of a list.
Format: {"HeadTailPattern": {"head": pattern, "tail": pattern}}

UnitPattern.description:
Pattern matching the unit value.
Compact: {"UnitPattern": {}}; expanded: {"UnitPattern": {"attributes": {...}}}

ValueSpecification.description:
Value specification (public interface - signature only, no implementation).

Canonical format: { "inputs": { "a": type, "b": type }, "output": type }
The "inputs" field can be omitted if empty.

Encoders should output the canonical object format.
Decoders should accept both object and legacy array formats.

inputs.description:
Input parameters.
Canonical (output): Object keyed by parameter name: { "x": type, "y": type }
Accepted (input): Array format: [["x", type], ["y", type]]
Can be omitted if empty (no inputs).

ValueDefinition.description:
Value definition body variant. When wrapped in AccessControlled (as in ModuleDefinition.values),
the structure is: { "access": "Public", "ExpressionBody": { ... } } or similar for other variants.
The wrapper object format uses the variant name as a key.

ExpressionBody.description:
Normal IR expression body with input types, output type, and expression body.
Used for most value definitions.

inputTypes.description:
Dictionary mapping input parameter names to their types.
V4 uses object format: { "param-name": type, ... }

NativeBody.description:
Native/builtin operation body (no IR expression).
Used for platform operations that don't have an IR representation.

inputTypes.description:
Dictionary mapping input parameter names to their types.
V4 uses object format: { "param-name": type, ... }

ExternalBinding.description: One per-target binding of an external definition.

externalName.description: Name of the external function on that platform

ExternalBody.description:
External definition body (decision 0008): one or more per-target bindings and an
optional fallback body, so a Gleam-style external with a body encodes faithfully.
The single-binding spelling with top-level externalName/targetPlatform is a legacy
spelling readers accept for one release (decision 0006); it is not valid here.
A targetPlatform value must be unique within externals; JSON Schema cannot express
that constraint, so readers enforce it (decision 0008).

inputTypes.description:
Dictionary mapping input parameter names to their types.
V4 uses object format: { "param-name": type, ... }

externals.description: Per-target bindings; a backend picks the one for its platform

body.description: Optional fallback expression for platforms with no binding

IncompleteBody.description:
Incomplete definition body (V4 feature for best-effort support).
Used when a definition cannot be fully resolved (e.g., deleted reference, type mismatch).

inputTypes.description:
Dictionary mapping input parameter names to their types.
V4 uses object format: { "param-name": type, ... }

DocumentLiteral.description:
Schema-less JSON-like document (decision 0013), typed morphir/SDK:document#document.
Number lexemes are preserved; readers must not narrow them to 64-bit floats.
A DocumentLiteral cannot appear in a LiteralPattern.
The document itself: any JSON value, carried verbatim. There is no { value } spelling.

NativeInfo.description:
Information about a native operation. Used in NativeBody to categorize
platform operations for optimization and code generation.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the native operation

NativeHint.description:
Categorization hint for native operations. Used by code generators
to select appropriate implementations or optimizations.

oneOf.description: Basic arithmetic/logic operation (add, subtract, multiply, etc.)
Comparison operation (equals, less than, greater than, etc.)
String operation (concat, split, etc.)
Collection operation (map, filter, fold, etc.)
Platform-specific operation

Incompleteness.description:
Reason for incomplete type or value definition. V4 feature for
best-effort IR generation when full resolution isn't possible.

oneOf.description: Hole due to unresolved reference or error

partialBody.description: Optional partial type information if available

oneOf.description: Author-marked work-in-progress

HoleReason.description:
Specific reason why a Hole exists in the IR. Used for error reporting
and to guide developers in fixing incomplete definitions.

oneOf.description: Reference to something that doesn't exist or was deleted

target.description: The FQName that could not be resolved

oneOf.description: Reference was deleted during a refactoring operation

tx-id.description: Transaction ID of the refactoring that deleted this reference

oneOf.description: Type mismatch error
